title: customer-service
questionPrompt:
Part 2: Describe a time when you received excellent customer service. You should say what the service was, when and where you received it, who provided it, and explain why you thought it was excellent.

Part 3: Why is good customer service important? How can businesses encourage customer loyalty?
cueCardPoints: When and where you received it
Why you thought it was excellent
sampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about a memorable visit to Riverside Market, where I experienced excellent customer service. I went there on a Saturday morning with my sister because we wanted to buy some fresh local produce. One stallholder noticed that we were unsure about the different kinds of honey, so she took the time to explain where each one came from and let us try a small sample. What impressed me most was that she went the extra mile without putting any pressure on us to buy anything. The whole interaction felt warm and genuine, and it made the market feel like a real community rather than just a place to shop. In the end, we bought a jar of local honey and some cheese, and I would definitely return. For a small business, this kind of personal attention can make a lasting impression. It builds trust, encourages repeat custom, and helps customers feel valued. In my view, good service is not simply about solving a problem; it is about creating an experience that people want to share with others.
